## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Romania recorded 6,954K actual service units in 2025, +9.2% compared to 2024 (6,369K).

- Actual 2025 service units were +2.6% above the plan (6,775K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +35.9% above the actual 2019 level (5,117K).
